args.content:
Done with the clear items. What I did:
- Deleted DataForge threads (E017, E018, E028), the team offsite receipt (E027) and Sameer's press query (E013).
- Titles updated: Karthik Iyer -> Principal Engineer, Tara Menon -> Talent Lead, Divya Menon -> Head of Customer Success, Rohan Kulkarni -> Head of Partnerships, Nidhi Kapoor -> Head of Security, Ananya Iyer -> Senior Data Scientist, Thomas George -> Workplace Experience Lead. Kavya Nair's city changed to Bengaluru.
- Calendar: Design sync (Aug 15, 3 PM, Arjun Rao), Budget review (Aug 14, 11 AM, Harish Gupta + Lata Pillai), Vendor transition review (Aug 20, 2 PM, Imran Sheikh + Priya Menon), CS kickoff (Aug 23, 3 PM, 45 min, Divya Menon + Priya Menon, as Divya's plan asked).
- Chats: product pod (design review moved to Friday), Design Guild (component library review on for Thursday), Rhea (2.4 good to ship), Manish Rao (ledger service stable; he's covering the backend pager while Pooja travels), Nidhi (audit cleared to start).
- Replies: Tara (schedule the onsite panel), Nikhil (deck to intros this week), Aisha (she organizes the Q3 board meeting; deck is ready), Mohit (cleared to publish the pen-test report), Divya (onboarding plan approved), Rohan Kulkarni (go ahead with the pilot), Vivek Nair (interim payments PM; audit passed).

What I couldn't do, and why:
1. CloudSpan "duplicate" invoice: E003 and E043 have the same subject and date but different totals (INR 4,20,000 vs 2,60,000), so they aren't copies. I didn't delete either. Which one is wrong?
2. Vendor renewal reply: no vendor email is about renewing. The only renewal thread is Northwind's "Not renewing: closing out our contract" (E042), and DataForge is offboarded. Which vendor do you mean?
3. Priya / Q3 budget: no Priya sent a Q3 budget email. The Q3 budget variance review is from Harish (E030), and Priya Menon sent Q4 budget planning (E029). Who should get the reply?
4. Platform lead (Arjun Menon) title: two org-chart emails from the same day disagree. Rahul's says Director, Platform and Sneha's (HR) says Principal Platform Engineer. Which is right?
5. Quarterly review "next Tuesday": no time, length or attendees given, and "next Tuesday" doesn't map to a clear date in your calendar (it's all August 2024).
6. Moving sprint planning to the afternoon: you have two sprint plannings (Aug 1 and Aug 15), and I can only add events, not move them.
7. Weekly planning: the "usual time" disagrees (Anjali says 4 PM, Arjun Menon says 3 PM), and there's no date.
8. Investor call: both Vivek Menon (Northstar) and Aditi Rao (Elevation) sent term sheets, and there's no date or time.
9. Startup catch-up group: two group chats are both called "Catch-up and Startup Updates" (Varun + Ishita, and Nikhil + Sara). Which one?
10. Landlord: George's latest email (E058) says he's ending the lease because he's selling the building, so I didn't confirm a renewal.
11. Sara's founder roundtable: she has since cancelled it (E059) and will reschedule, so I didn't RSVP.
12. Product designer: both Ishan Gupta (design system proposal, E036) and Simran Kaur (portfolio feedback, E024) are product designers who sent work. Which one?
